testcase.name: listedTests reads every test of a --list report, keyed as durations.json names it
the longest tests go first, each to the least loaded shard: the shards balance by time, not count
the plan is deterministic: the same list in another order gives the same shards
every listed test lands in exactly one shard, an untimed one at its file's mean time
the completeness check names a dropped, a duplicated and an unlisted test
without timings, or with too few of the listed tests timed, it falls back to Playwright's --shard
a file that cannot be split by test goes whole to one shard: serial, a title the list cannot name, a title that prefixes another
each shard's lines select exactly its tests, read as Playwright reads a --test-list
mergeTimings: a browser seen whole replaces its times, a partial one keeps the rest, a failed test keeps its old time
plan writes each shard's test list and plan.json, and gives Playwright its arguments
plan falls back to --shard=N/M when the timings file is missing, and says why
plan refuses a list it cannot read: a shard must never run a guess
verify passes when Playwright lists exactly the shard's tests, and fails naming a dropped or an extra one
timings reads every shard's durations.json into the timings file plan reads
